newsHighlights.title: Relief efforts intensify after Xizang quake kills 16, injures 76
newsHighlights.summary: Relief and rescue efforts have intensified after a 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Xizang, killing 16 people and injuring 76 others.
newsHighlights.translation: 西藏发生7.0级地震，造成16人遇难、76人受伤，救援救灾工作正在加紧进行。

newsHighlights.title: Communication services restored in quake-hit Xizang
newsHighlights.summary: Repair crews have restored home broadband and dedicated line services in the county seat of Drachen, as well as a key mobile base station near the epicenter.
newsHighlights.translation: 抢修队伍已恢复定日县县城的家庭宽带和专线服务，以及震中附近的一座关键移动基站。

newsHighlights.title: Xi orders all-out rescue work in Xizang
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping ordered all-out rescue work and urged efforts to minimize casualties and losses after the earthquake.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席要求全力开展救援工作，努力把人员伤亡和损失降到最低。

newsHighlights.title: Israel launches army operation in West Bank, Hebron families displaced
newsHighlights.summary: Families in Hebron were displaced as the Israeli army launched an operation in the West Bank, worsening the humanitarian situation.
newsHighlights.translation: 以色列军队在约旦河西岸发起军事行动，希伯伦的家庭被迫流离失所，人道主义局势恶化。

quote.author: Rachel Carson
quote.translation: 在自然界中，没有什么是孤立存在的。
quote.explanation: 这句名言提醒我们，人类社会、基础设施与自然环境彼此相连。灾害发生时，环境的脆弱会直接转化为人的损失，因此可持续发展必须重视生态保护与防灾减灾。

vocabulary.definition: 地震（earthquake 的非正式说法）
vocabulary.example: A powerful quake struck Xizang early Sunday morning.
vocabulary.translation: 一场强烈地震于周日清晨袭击了西藏。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自标题「Rescue efforts continue after 7.0-magnitude quake in Xizang」。

vocabulary.example: The 7.0-magnitude earthquake caused serious damage to local infrastructure.
vocabulary.translation: 这场7.0级地震对当地基础设施造成了严重破坏。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自「a 7.0-magnitude quake in Xizang」的报道。

vocabulary.example: Repair crews have restored communication services in the quake-hit area.
vocabulary.translation: 抢修队伍已恢复地震灾区的通信服务。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自标题「Communication services restored in quake-hit Xizang」。

vocabulary.definition: 救济，救援；（痛苦等的）减轻
vocabulary.example: Relief efforts intensified as more rescue teams arrived at the scene.
vocabulary.translation: 随着更多救援队抵达现场，救灾工作不断加强。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自标题「Relief efforts intensify after Xizang quake kills 16」。

vocabulary.definition: 使流离失所；使离开原居地
vocabulary.example: Hundreds of families were displaced by the conflict and the disaster.
vocabulary.translation: 数百个家庭因冲突和灾害而流离失所。

vocabulary.definition: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
vocabulary.example: Building resilient infrastructure is essential for sustainable development.
vocabulary.translation: 建设有韧性的基础设施对可持续发展至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与地震灾后通信、交通等基础设施快速抢修恢复的新闻内容相关。

vocabulary.example: The quake damaged roads, bridges and other vital infrastructure.
vocabulary.translation: 地震损坏了道路、桥梁和其他重要基础设施。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与西藏地震后宽带、专线、移动基站等基础设施受损抢修的报道相关。

vocabulary.example: Rescuers worked around the clock to keep casualties to a minimum.
vocabulary.translation: 救援人员昼夜奋战，力求把伤亡降到最低。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自「Xi orders all-out rescue work」中要求最大限度减少伤亡的表述。

vocabulary.example: Earthquakes are a natural hazard that sustainable planning must take into account.
vocabulary.translation: 地震是可持续规划必须考虑的自然灾害隐患。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与西藏7.0级地震引发的次生灾害风险相关。

vocabulary.example: Sustainable reconstruction should combine safety with environmental protection.
vocabulary.translation: 可持续的重建应把安全与环境保护结合起来。
vocabulary.newsContext: 与今日地震灾后重建相关的可持续发展主题相呼应。

pattern.pattern: Efforts to do sth. intensify / continue after ...
pattern.example: Relief efforts intensify after Xizang quake kills 16, injures 76.
pattern.translation: 西藏地震造成16人遇难、76人受伤，救援工作正在加紧进行。
pattern.usage: 该句型用于描述某事发生后，相关行动不断加强或持续。结构为「名词 + 动词 + after + 事件」，常见于新闻标题。也可以说：Efforts to restore communication services continue after the earthquake.

grammar.title: 现在完成时（Present Perfect）在新闻报道中的运用
grammar.explanation: 现在完成时（have/has + 过去分词）用于强调过去发生的动作对现在造成的结果或影响，在新闻英语中非常常见，尤其在报道刚刚完成的救援、抢修等行动时。与一般过去时相比，现在完成时更突出「目前的状态」。
examples: Repair crews from China Mobile Tietong's Xizang branch have restored home broadband and dedicated line services in the county seat of Drachen.
Rescue teams have arrived at the epicenter and emergency supplies have been delivered to affected residents.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 -si- 上，读作 ri-ZIL-yuhns。注意 /l/ 后接 /j/（y 音），舌尖抵上齿龈，气流从舌两侧通过，不要读成「re-zil-ee-ens」。中间的 /ɪ/ 是短元音，发音短促。
examples: Community resilience is key to surviving natural disasters.
The country showed great resilience in the face of the earthquake.

reading.title: Rebuilding After the Quake: Toward a More Resilient and Sustainable Future
reading.content:
A 7.0-magnitude earthquake struck Xizang on Sunday, killing 16 people and injuring 76. Rescue and relief efforts intensified immediately, as President Xi Jinping ordered all-out rescue work to minimize casualties and losses.

Communication was quickly restored in the affected areas. Repair crews from China Mobile Tietong's Xizang branch have restored home broadband and dedicated line services in the county seat of Drachen, as well as a key mobile base station near the epicenter.

Disasters like this remind us that sustainable development is not only about clean energy and green growth. It also means building resilient infrastructure that can withstand natural hazards and protecting the environment that shelters us all. As Rachel Carson wrote, "In nature, nothing exists alone." Truly sustainable reconstruction must therefore respect nature while keeping people safe.
reading.translation:
周日，西藏发生7.0级地震，造成16人遇难、76人受伤。习近平主席要求全力开展救援工作，把人员伤亡和损失降到最低，救援救灾工作随即迅速展开。

受灾地区的通信很快得到恢复。中国铁通西藏分公司的抢修队伍已恢复定日县县城的家庭宽带和专线服务，以及震中附近的一座关键移动基站。

这样的灾害提醒我们，可持续发展不仅仅是清洁能源和绿色增长，它还意味着建设能够抵御自然灾害的韧性基础设施，以及保护庇护我们所有人的环境。正如蕾切尔·卡森所写：「在自然界中，没有什么是孤立存在的。」因此，真正可持续的重建必须在保障人民安全的同时尊重自然。
reading.sourceNote: 本文根据 ChinaDaily《Relief efforts intensify after Xizang quake kills 16, injures 76》《Communication services restored in quake-hit Xizang》《Xi orders all-out rescue work in Xizang》等今日真实新闻改写，并结合「环境与可持续发展」主题拓展。
